Electric furnaces are a source of heat generated from electricity.

It's recommended to circulate the fluid through the furnace for better efficiency

## Electric furnace

[![Electric Furnace](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/7/7a/Electric_Furnace.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/268?cb=20260817153847)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/7/7a/Electric_Furnace.png/revision/latest?cb=20260817153847)

## Mechanics

Electric furnaces heat fluid using electricity. The fluid can reach a maximum temperature of ~372 inside the furnace when no fluid is moving through it.

The heat generation of the furnace slows down the higher the temperature is

Electric furnaces also produce ambient heat.
